d: The Iran war is triggering an energy shock across Asia, with rising oil prices, shipping disruptions and fuel shortages exposing vulnerabilities in Pakistan, while India relies on diversified oil imports, ethanol blending and other buffers. Meanwhile, a Reddit post alleging the mass dismissal of 80 Indian customer-service employees during a brief Google Meet highlights a growing trend of digital layoffs. From fuel protests to sudden job cuts, the crises reveal the human and economic costs of global instability and corporate efficiency. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more
